notes: All databases / services are managed SaaS (Supabase, E2B, Aliyun APIG, K8s ACK).
No Docker containers are owned by this harness; setup-env.sh only validates env vars.
secrets[].test_value is intentionally empty — fill from your own .env or shell exports.

runtime.test_command: cd agent-manager && npx vitest run tests/unit
runtime.install_command: cd agent-manager && npm install && cd server && npm install

databases.test_alternative: Use a dedicated Supabase project (e.g. *.supabase.co) configured for the test env; no local PG.

services.purpose: AI Gateway routing (provider auth + consumer keys). Optional.
ACK / ACS cluster for SandboxSet CRD admin views. Optional.

secrets.name: API_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: AES-GCM key used by server/utils/crypto.js to encrypt provider / channel credentials at rest. 32 bytes base64.

secrets.name: SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service-role JWT used by the backend admin client.

secrets.name: TERMINAL_SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC secret for terminal session tokens (services/terminal.js).

functional_scenarios.name: health_check
functional_scenarios.description: Backend boots and /api/health returns 200 with status:up.
functional_scenarios.expected_outcome: Server is healthy, Supabase reachable from boot.

functional_scenarios.name: version_endpoint
steps: Compare response.version with cat agent-manager/version.json | jq -r .version
